scripts.text:
[Guide]
This castle has a hidden secret.
That is the ^4d4dff'Okolnir'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
这座城堡隐藏着一个秘密。
那就是^4d4dff“奥科尔尼尔”^000000。

scripts.text: About Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 关于奥科尔尼尔

scripts.text: Go to Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 前往奥科尔尼尔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okolnir is a kind of virtual realm...
I don't know how Okolnir exists, but I guess only Valkyrie knows.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
奥科尔尼尔是一种虚拟领域...
我不知道奥科尔尼尔是如何存在的，但我想只有瓦尔基里知道。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
As you know this is a place to test the adventurers made by Valkyrie...
...you know the qualifications to enter Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
如您所知，这里是瓦尔基里用来考验冒险者的地方...
...您应该知道进入奥科尔尼尔的条件。

scripts.text: Qualifications?
scripts.translation: 条件？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Yes, Valkyrie definitely prefers strong adventurers.
Only the qualified can enter Okolnir and Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
是的，瓦尔基里肯定更青睐强大的冒险者。
只有符合条件的人才能进入奥科尔尼尔和瓦尔哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It only opens when everyone comes together to work it out.
The key is in the castle.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
它只在大家齐心协力时才会开启。
钥匙就在城堡里。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If a castle's ^4d4dffeconomy is over 65 and defense also over 30^000000, this will be acceptable to access Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
如果城堡的^4d4dff经济超过65且防御超过30^000000，就可以满足进入奥科尔尼尔的条件。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
And, if you pass all of the tests given by Valkyrie in Okolnir!
You will also receive a mysterious gift.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
而且，如果您通过了瓦尔基里在奥科尔尼尔中给出的所有考验！
您还将获得一份神秘的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Would you like to try to enter here?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
您想尝试进入这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Great! Economy and Defense are OK.
You can enter Okolnir now....
Do you want to go there?
scripts.translation:
[向导]
太好了！经济和防御都达标了。
您现在可以进入奥科尔尼尔了....
您想去那里吗？

scripts.text: Sure let's go there.
scripts.translation: 好的，我们走吧。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok......
Please follow me...

[Guide]
You can try this anytime in the future...
If you are ready to protect this castle.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
您以后随时都可以尝试...
如果您准备好守护这座城堡的话。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You are not qualified yet.
Please develop your castle more...
scripts.translation:
[向导]
您目前还不符合条件。
请继续发展您的城堡...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... OK...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
...好的...
祝您好运。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 现在进入

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hope you get everything you want...
scripts.translation:
[向导]
希望您能如愿以偿...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Really?
Sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
真的吗？
听到这个消息我很遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Building Okolnir needs quite a long time.
....even though it's only virtual...
scripts.translation:
[向导]
建造奥科尔尼需要相当长的时间。
...尽管它只是虚拟的...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It takes about 12 - 13 hours to create the virtual realm.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
创建这个虚拟领域大约需要12到13个小时。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You'll have to wait.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
你得等待。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... I've never seen you before.
You are strangers here. You'd better get out of here right now.
scripts.translation:
[向导]
...我从未见过你。
你是这里的陌生人。你最好现在就离开。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I am... Wish maiden.
Mourning in this virtual realm, Okolnir.
On behalf of the humanbeings who defeated God here.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我是...许愿少女。
在这个虚拟领域奥科尔尼中哀悼。
代表那些在此击败神明的凡人。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Are you ready to endure the trials to get the Goddess' glory?
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你准备好承受试炼，以获取女神的光辉了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了

scripts.text: Sorry, I'll try later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will test whether or not you deserve the Goddess shine...
Isn't it simple?
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我将测试你是否配得上女神的光辉...
这很简单，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Okolnir is a virtual place.
There is no room for error there.
^ff0000You only have one hour.^000000
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
奥科尔尼是一个虚拟的地方。
那里没有容错的空间。
^ff0000你只有一小时的时间。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
If you have not finished in that time, Okolnir will be destroyed, and I will go to rest.
You will have to wait again...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
如果你没有在规定时间内完成，奥科尔尼将被摧毁，我也将安息。
你将不得不重新等待...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Are you ready to go through?
^4d4dffYou need to have 16 to 20 members present^000000.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你准备好通过了吗？
^4d4dff你需要有16到20名成员在场^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will open the gate of Okolnir if your members are ready.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
如果你的成员准备好了，我将打开奥科尔尼的大门。

scripts.text: We are ready.
scripts.translation: 我们准备好了。

scripts.text: We need more time.
scripts.translation: 我们需要更多时间。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Now I will open the gate of Okolnir where I am.
I will wait for you on the top of Okolnir...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
现在我将打开奥科尔尼的大门。
我会在奥科尔尼的顶端等你...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I hope that you can complete all of the trials before the virtual Okolnir is destroyed...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我希望你能在虚拟的奥科尔尼被摧毁之前完成所有试炼...
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You need to have 16 to 20 members present to open the gate of Okolnir.
Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你需要有16到20名成员在场才能打开奥科尔尼的大门。
准备好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Don't hesitate to try.
You should catch the chance when it comes to you.
Just gather your fellow members.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
不要犹豫去尝试。
当机会来临时，你应该抓住它。
只需召集你的同伴成员。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
... Are you afraid of
the trials facing you?
....
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
...你害怕
面前等待你的试炼吗？
....

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Do you think that you can defeat the Goddess shine easily?
I feel disappointed by all of you.
Just go away...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你以为能轻易击败女神的光辉吗？
我对你们所有人感到失望。
请离开...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Do you wish to enter?
Only those prepared may enter here.
You must bring several items to enter Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你希望进入吗？
只有做好准备的人才能进入这里。
你必须携带若干物品才能进入奥科尔尼。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Dusk Glow
Dawn Essence
Cold Moonlight
Hazy Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
黄昏的光芒
黎明的露珠
冰冷的月光
阴暗的星光。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Goddess Tear
Valkyrie's Token
Brynhild Armor Piece
Hero Remains
Valkyrie Armor
Andvari's Ring.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
女神的眼泪
瓦尔基里的象征
布伦希尔德的铠甲碎片
英雄的遗骸
瓦尔基里铠甲
安德巴里的戒指。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Please bring those four things, 10 Agate, 10 Rose Quartz, and 20 Elunium,
a Heavenly Maiden's Robe, as well as 100 Soft feathers.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
请携带那四样东西、10个玛瑙、10个玫瑰石英、20个铝，
一件天女长袍，以及100根软羽。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You must bring those six things, 10 Gold, and 20 Elunium.
Many Valhala's Flowers are also required as an offering.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你必须携带那六样东西、10个金币和20个铝。
还需要许多巴哈拉的花作为祭品。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Once all of those are prepared, the gate will open.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
当所有这些都准备就绪时，大门将会打开。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
.... 
...........The Goddess shines brightly down on you, you should be stronger to deserve it...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
.... 
...........女神的光辉照耀着你，你应该变得更强以配得上它...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Remember...
You need to collect many soft feathers.
I hope that your dreams come true.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
记住...
你需要收集许多软羽。
我希望你的梦想成真。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will answer all your requests if you bring these to me.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
如果你把这些带给我，我会满足你所有的请求。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I am... Wish maiden.
Mourning in this virtual realm, Okolnir.
On behalf of the humanbeings who defeated God here.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我是...许愿少女。
在这个虚拟领域奥科尔尼中哀悼。
代表那些在此击败神明的凡人。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Bring me the one who brought you to this place.
.. Deliver him to my will.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
把带你来到此地的人交给我。
.. 将他交付于我的意志。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
...You are not qualified.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
...你不符合资格。

scripts.text: There are too many people, you can't enter.
scripts.translation: 人太多了，无法进入。

scripts.text: The Warp Gate responds to the Crystal Key.
scripts.translation: 传送门响应水晶钥匙。

scripts.text: You need the Crystal Key to activate the Warp Gate.
scripts.translation: 你需要水晶钥匙来激活传送门。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
As I declared, I will give the Goddess' shine to you.
You have the requirements to carry it...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
正如我所宣布的，我将把女神的光辉赐予你。
你具备承载它的资格...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You will be granted the power of the great Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你将获得伟大的瓦尔基里的力量...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will give you some things for fun.
All of you enjoy them together...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我会给你们一些好玩的东西。
大家一起享受吧...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Go to Rachel and Juno to meet the Ravies sisters.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
去拉赫和朱诺见见拉维姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will open the gate for you to come back here.
...Okolnir won't last forever...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
我会为你打开大门让你回来。
...奥科尔尼不会永远存在...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
As I declared, you are worthy of holding the {0}.
However, you do not have the requirements on you...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
正如我所宣布的，你有资格持有{0}。
然而，你并不具备相应的条件...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
...Did you forget something?
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
...你忘了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
All of you worked together as a team...
Humans are strong when they are united, but are easily swayed by lust.
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
你们所有人都是作为一个团队共同奋斗的...
人类团结起来时是强大的，但很容易被欲望所左右。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Humans are imperfect, so their chief god is there for them when they need help.
....
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
人类是不完美的，所以当他们需要帮助时，他们的主神会守护他们。
....

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Always be real.
Do not regret your actions...
scripts.translation:
[许愿少女]
永远保持真实。
不要后悔你的行为...
